mentions.name: Relevant Chrome extension
mentions.description: A Chrome extension that lets users interact with Relevant directly from within YouTube, making it easier to find YouTube content that fits their interests without having to navigate to the Relevant website. A first version is targeted for release within about a month to spread the idea and gather feedback.
mentions.problem: Relevant's website had low engagement because navigating to a separate site to find content is a big ask; more broadly, YouTube's recommendations repeat one or two watched topics and its 'Not Interested' tool barely changes them.
mentions.source_excerpt: This year I decided that I'd bring the content to them by making a Chrome extension that lets users interact with Relevant directly from within YouTube.
